behavior_0x47.name: Behavior_0x47_lower_tower_terrain_handler
behavior_0x47.effect: When 0x00FFF0BD is clear and TERRAIN_SURFACE_LATCH is clear, writes 0xFF to TERRAIN_SURFACE_LATCH and toggles TERRAIN_SURFACE_MODE.
behavior_0x47.classification: surface-mode/latch handler, not an actor spawn or scene transition

behavior_0x22_0x23.name: Behavior_0x22_0x23_vertical_connector_handler
behavior_0x22_0x23.effect: Writes 0xFF to TERRAIN_QUERY_STATE_A; the player terrain response state machine consumes the resulting query.

player_response.name: Player_TerrainResponseStateMachine
player_response.effect: Resolves the current terrain behavior, clears query/latch state for ordinary cells, and applies the player response or normal vertical integration. Scene state 0x08 bypasses this path.
